pairs.subject: agent-cli-transport
pairs.evidence: lib/claudeCli.ts:339 Headless Claude CLI transport wraps the local binary with seat-only auth, strict sandbox arguments, floored timeouts, tree termination, and output normalization behind the router's fallback ladder.

techniques.evidence: lib/claudeCli.ts:195 Zero-token probe runs claude --version through the spawn door with seatOnlyEnv(), naming its ceiling that login state is proven on real calls.
lib/claudeCli.ts:155 Strips METERED_AUTH_VARS at the single spawn door so no ambient API key can silently convert seat runs to metered billing.
lib/claudeCli.ts:281 Quotes empty tool allowlist on Windows shell to prevent the interpreter from dropping the zero-length argument and erasing restrictions.
lib/text/providers/claudeCli.ts:60 Records schema enforcement capability with tool version and verification date, driving prompt augmentation when false.
lib/text/router.ts:408 Selects preferred local CLI transport before falling back to alternate metered cloud provider, recording the rung on the result.
lib/claudeCli.ts:318 Normalizes single JSON result object, extracting text and metadata while classifying envelope error subtypes.
lib/claudeCli.ts:282 Enforces generate stance by disallowing all tools and capping execution to a single turn.
lib/text/types.ts:37 Transport runs headless non-interactive batch turns with no tool permissions; no human is in the loop to route mid-turn approvals.
lib/text/types.ts:38 Transport calls are stateless one-shot executions capped at one turn; conversation threads are never persisted or resumed across spawns.
